messages:
external-auditor: Hi team — auditor here. We need an evidence bundle and a concise playback for a service-account RBAC change from 2024-11-17 14:20 UTC. Specifically: change request, who approved, rolebindings modified, KMS access events, and any related incident/ticket. Can you provide a time-windowed log export + short timeline?
ellen: thanks — confirming windows. request is 2024-11-17 14:00–15:00 UTC, correct?
external-auditor: correct, plus 30min before/after (13:30–15:30) for context.
samir: noted. tracking ticket INF-4821. i'll grab k8s rolebinding events and cloudtrail for the service account. giving ETA ~ 2h.
maria: i'll pull KMS key usage logs and Splunk traces for the same window. will highlight any Decrypt/GenerateDataKey calls.
leah: FYI the RBAC change was a devops request to add the svc-inference-sa to cluster-admin in the staging cluster, approved by @ellen in the internal PR. i can attach the PR link.
essential-bot: (automated) Ticket INF-4821 created by samir.
samir: attaching the RBAC change command we applied: ```kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: svc-inference-admin
  namespace: kube-system
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: svc-inference-sa
  namespace: inference
roleRef:
  kind: ClusterRole
  name: cluster-admin
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
EOF
```
ellen: question for auditor — do you need screenshots of the PR approval flow or just links and commits?
external-auditor: links + signed approval log is fine. a screenshot helps but not required. we need the approver identity mapping to an SSO account.
maria: KMS export in progress. pulling CloudTrail entries for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 between 2024-11-17T13:30:00Z and 2024-11-17T15:30:00Z. will redact customer ids. ETA 1.5h.
samir: for k8s audit logs, i can filter by `user.agent` and `user.username="system:serviceaccount:inference:svc-inference-sa"` and actions `create` on `rolebindings`. command: ```kubectl get events --all-namespaces --field-selector involvedObject.name=svc-inference-sa -o json | jq '.items[] | {ts:.metadata.creationTimestamp, verb:.verb, resource:.involvedObject.kind, name:.involvedObject.name, user:.user.username}'```
leah: there was an unrelated vulnerability triage that day (VULN-2024-1116) — i've added a note in the ticket in case the auditor wants correlation. not expected to be linked but leaving the audit trail.
ellen: also: we performed a config rollback at 15:05 UTC for a follow-up permission tweak. include that in timeline.
external-auditor: please include the rollback command and who executed it.
maria: CloudTrail snippet (redacted): ```{ "eventTime": "2024-11-17T14:22:10Z", "eventName": "GenerateDataKey", "userIdentity": {"arn":"arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/redwood-infra/svc-inference-sa"}, "requestParameters": {"keyId":"abcd-ef01"}}```
samir: k8s audit events show the RoleBinding creation at 2024-11-17T14:21:12Z by `system:controller:rbac` (controller applied the change after approved PR). user commit shows the approver as `ellen@redwood`.
leah: rollback applied by samir at 2024-11-17T15:05:42Z (kubectl delete rolebinding svc-inference-admin -n kube-system). logged in ticket INF-4821.
ellen: i'll export the PR metadata and SSO mapping from Okta and attach hashes.
external-auditor: excellent. can you also provide a short narrative (1–2 paragraphs) that explains why the change was requested and what mitigation controls were in place?
samir: drafting the narrative: "Change requested to enable one-off debugging for a failing inference job in staging. Mitigations: change applied to staging only, timeboxed, reviewed by eng lead, KMS keys access monitored, rollback completed within 45 minutes. No production secrets were exposed."
maria: KMS log bundle ready. uploading to S3 path `s3://redwood-audit-exports/INF-4821/1710849999-kms-ct-export.tar.gz`. pre-signed URL: https://s3-presigned.example/INF-4821-kms.tar.gz (expires in 48h).
external-auditor: receipt confirmed. i see the CloudTrail and KMS bundle. one follow-up: can you show that there were no simultaneous API tokens being minted for that service account from an unexpected IP?
leah: i'll run a token-issue check against our auth logs (Auth0). command: `jq '.events[] | select(.type=="token.issued" and .actor=="svc-inference-sa")' auth0-20241117.json` — will report back.
ellen: also flagging that we had an oncall incident later that week; linking for context: INC-7712. not related but included.
samir: quick note for packaging: i'm creating a small evidence manifest (CSV) with files, checksums, and extraction commands for handoff. will attach to ticket.
maria: auth logs: no token issuance from unknown IPs within 13:30–15:30 window. all token issuances originate from our CI subnet 10.240.0.0/20.
external-auditor: that's great. final ask: can you provide a timeline doc and attach the PR link, KMS bundle link, k8s audit extract, and the rollback command? after that we should be able to close the evidence request.
ellen: will create a consolidated zip and drop in the S3 folder with a README timeline. aiming to finish in ~45m.
leah: i've also added a short note about remediation: add a policy to prevent cluster-admin grants to non-human service accounts without an exception workflow. filed as RFC-2024-34.
samir: INF-4821 updated with manifest and timeline. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4821
external-auditor: thanks all — we'll review and follow up if anything else comes up. :white_check_mark:
